name: Write detailed fictional battle scenarios and fight scripts
description: Users asked the AI to generate detailed, step-by-step fight scenarios and battle narratives between fictional or original characters, often incorporating specific stats, move lists, dice rolls, and dialogue. Many requests focused on crossover matchups, power scaling hierarchies, or iterative refinement of combat outcomes and character transformations.
